itinerary:
Day 1: Culinary Introduction
- Morning (8am-12pm): Visit the Local Market in Old Town
- Lunch: The Spice House, try the Chicken Biryani
- Afternoon (1pm-5pm): Food tour in the city
- Dinner: The Flaming Grill, recommended Grilled Fish
- Evening: Explore the Night Bazaar
- Estimated daily spend: Rs 4000 per person
- Local tip: Always drink bottled water

Day 2: Street Food
- Morning (8am-12pm): Street food tour in Downtown
- Lunch: Mama's Kitchen, try the Veggie Wrap
- Afternoon (1pm-5pm): Visit the Food Museum
- Dinner: The Curry House, recommended Chicken Tikka
- Evening: Walk along the Riverfront
- Estimated daily spend: Rs 3500 per person
- Local tip: Bargain at street stalls

Day 3: Local Delicacies
- Morning (8am-12pm): Visit the Local Bakery in Uptown
- Lunch: The Tasty Cafe, try the Local Quiche
- Afternoon (1pm-5pm): Wine and cheese tasting
- Dinner: The Gourmet Restaurant, recommended Steak
- Evening: Live music at the Jazz Club
- Estimated daily spend: Rs 5000 per person
- Local tip: Book wine tasting in advance

Day 4: Cooking Class
- Morning (8am-12pm): Cooking class at the Culinary School
- Lunch: The School Cafe, try the prepared dishes
- Afternoon (1pm-5pm): Visit the Organic Farm
- Dinner: The Farmhouse, recommended Farm-to-Table
- Evening: Stargazing at the farm
- Estimated daily spend: Rs 4500 per person
- Local tip: Wear comfortable shoes

Day 5: Food Festival
- Morning (8am-12pm): Visit the Food Festival in the Park
- Lunch: Festival Food Stalls, try the Local BBQ
- Afternoon (1pm-5pm): Explore the festival activities
- Dinner: The Festival Restaurant, recommended Seafood
- Evening: Closing ceremony at the festival
- Estimated daily spend: Rs 4200 per person
- Local tip: Arrive early to avoid crowds
recommendations:
TOP RESTAURANTS
Le Bernardin, Seafood, $120-$200 (INR 9000-15000), must-order Pan-Seared Scallops.
Carbone, Italian-American, $50-$100 (INR 3750-7500), must-order Veal Parmesan.
Peter Luger Steak House, Steakhouse, $60-$150 (INR 4500-11250), must-order Porterhouse Steak.
Di Fara Pizza, Pizzeria, $15-$30 (INR 1125-2250), must-order Classic Square Pie.
Katz's Delicatessen, Jewish Deli, $20-$50 (INR 1500-3750), must-order Pastrami Sandwich.

TOP ATTRACTIONS
The High Line, to walk along an elevated park, best time to go is early morning, entry fee is free.
Metropolitan Museum of Art, to see a vast collection of art, best time to go is weekday afternoons, entry fee is $25 (INR 1875).
Central Park, to relax in a large public park, best time to go is sunset, entry fee is free.
9/11 Memorial & Museum, to pay respects to victims, best time to go is morning, entry fee is $24 (INR 1800).
Brooklyn Bridge, to walk across a historic bridge, best time to go is early evening, entry fee is free.

HIDDEN GEMS
Washington Square Park, a charming park with a famous arch.
The Morbid Anatomy Museum, a quirky museum with unusual exhibits.
New York Earth Room, an indoor sculpture featuring 280,000 pounds of dirt.

TRAVEL TIPS
Respect local customs by tipping at least 15% in restaurants.
Use the subway as the best transport option, with a single ride costing $3 (INR 225).
Avoid common scams like paying for fake tickets or overpriced street goods.
Useful phrases include "excuse me" and "thank you", pronounced as "ex-KYOOZ me" and "THANK yoo".
Be aware of pickpocketing in crowded areas and keep valuables secure.

SHOPPING
Bloomingdale's, to buy designer clothing, price range $50-$500 (INR 3750-37500).
Grand Central Market, to buy local food and gifts, price range $10-$50 (INR 750-3750).
Brooklyn Flea, to buy vintage goods and souvenirs, price range $20-$100 (INR 1500-7500).
